messages.author: 55bbe902b1e4d092
messages.subject: Simulation Stuck
parts:
Hi all,

I am facing an issue in the simulation process in R-SWAT. I have two models, one with a lake and another without. When I import the project without a lake, the calibration tool works perfectly. However, when adding the one that contains the lake, the tool stuck without giving an error message.

I checked the parameter ranges, the output files, the print file, and the file.cio, and all were as they should be, I think.

Could you please help me figure out what could be the reason for this and what I can do?


Best regards,
Aseel Mohamed

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Simulation Stuck
parts:
If the simulation is stuck (running for infinte amount of time) then it means that SWAT/or SWAT+ does not run with your txtinout files => one issue could be your parameters range is out of the range defined by SWAT+ it SWAT+ just does not run in this case - without giving any warning message to the screen. Because SWAT+ does not run, so the 
channel_sd_mon and channel_sd_day

files are empty (they haven't been created by SWAT+)
